values.value: Re-price renewal line below list on {primaryRecordId}

1. Open Quote Line {primaryRecordId} — renewal net price {renewalNetPrice} is {percentBelowList}% below current list {currentListPrice}. 2. Confirm whether SBQQ__PricingMethod__c is set to Manual (consultant override) or the calculated path failed. 3. If Manual: capture the discount approval per company policy, OR restore to list. 4. If calculated: investigate why the PricebookEntry path didn't pick the current list price. 5. Re-calculate the quote and confirm the activated Order will book at the corrected price.
Discount approved by sales leadership; capturing on the quote.
Re-priced to list; customer notified of corrected renewal.
